_note: Into the Quiet: one line a day, morning (04:00-14:59) and evening. Berean Standard Bible clauses (public domain, bereanbible.com/bsb.txt) as placeholders; the NIV is fetched at build time by scripts/fetch_verses.py. Clauses chosen by Claude, approved by Matt 2026-11-16.

morning.text: In the morning, O LORD, You hear my voice
Let me hear Your loving devotion in the morning, for I have put my trust in You
They are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness!
Be still and know that I am God
those who wait upon the LORD will renew their strength
Satisfy us in the morning with Your loving devotion
This is the day that the LORD has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
But I will sing of Your strength and proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning
You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind, because he trusts in You.
In God alone my soul finds rest; my salvation comes from Him
to gaze on the beauty of the LORD and seek Him in His temple
You will fill me with joy in Your presence
Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you
Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

evening.text: I will lie down and sleep in peace, for You alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.
He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.
Behold, the Protector of Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
even the darkness is not dark to You, but the night shines like the day
When I remember You on my bed, I think of You through the watches of the night.
He makes me lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside quiet waters.
Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul
And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts
Rest in God alone, O my soul, for my hope comes from Him.
Return to your rest, O my soul, for the LORD has been good to you.
your strength would lie in quiet confidence
at night His song is with me
Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.
I lie down and sleep; I wake again, for the LORD sustains me.
